chapterInfo.content:
1
Wɔhunu Yesu a wasɔreɛ no
1 # Luk 1.3 Teofilo, akane nwoma a meyɛeɛ no fa nnoɔma a Yesu firii aseɛ yɛeɛ, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛeɛ nyinaa 2de bɛsii da a ɔnam Honhom Kronkron soɔ maa asomafoɔ a ɔyii wɔn no ahyɛdeɛ, na wɔfaa no kɔɔ soro no ho. 3Wɔn nso na n’amanehunu akyiri no, ɔnam adanseɛ bebree so yii ne ho kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ ɔteasefoɔ adaduanan mu maa wɔhunuu no, na ɔkaa Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛm. 4#Yoh 15.26; Luk 24.49 Na ɔne wɔn hyiaeɛ no, ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmfiri Yerusalem nnkɔ, na mmom wɔntwɛn Agya no bɔhyɛ a ɔse: Mote firii m’anomu no, 5#Mat 3.11 sɛ Yohane deɛ, ɔde nsuo na ɛbɔɔ asu, na mo deɛ, nna yi mu, ɛrenkyɛ na wɔbɛbɔ mo asu Honhom Kronkron mu.
6 # Luk 24.21 Ɛnna wɔhyiaeɛ no, wɔbisaa no sɛ: Awurade, berɛ yi mu na wobɛsane de ahennie no ama Israel anaa? 7Na ɔbuaa wɔn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mo asɛm, sɛ mobɛhunu berɛ anaa nna a Agya no ahyɛ ato hɔ ɔno ara ne tumi mu, 8na mmom sɛ Honhom Kronkron no nya ba mo so a, mobɛnya ahoɔden, na moayɛ m’adansefoɔ Yerusalem ne Yudea nyinaa ne Samaria de akɔpem asase ano nohoa.
Yesu sorokɔ
9 # Mar 16.19; Luk 24.51 Na ɔkaa yeinom wieeɛ na wɔrehwɛ no no, wɔmaa no so, na mununkum gyee no firii wɔn anim. 10#Luk 24.4 Na ɔrekorɔ na wɔrehwɛ soro haa no, hwɛ, mmarima baanu bi a wɔhyɛ ntadeɛ fitaa bɛgyinaa wɔn nkyɛn, 11#Luk 21.27 na wɔkaa nso sɛ: Galilea mmarima, adɛn na mogyina ha rehwɛ soro yi? Yesu yi ara a wɔafa no mo nkyɛn kɔ soro yi, ɔbɛba saa ara, sɛdeɛ mohu no sɛ ɔrekɔ soro yi.
Asomafoɔ no hyia Yerusalem
12 # Luk 24.50; 24.52-53 Ɛno na wɔfirii bepɔ a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔ a ɛbɛn Yerusalem bɛyɛ homeda kwan no so sane kɔɔ Yerusalem. 13#Luk 6.13-16 Na wɔduruu hɔ no, wɔkɔɔ abansoro dan no mu; ɛhɔ na na Petro ne Yohane ne Yakobo ne Andrea, Filipo ne Toma, Bartolomeo ne Mateo, Alfeo ba Yakobo ne Simon Selote ne Yakobo ba Yuda teɛ. 14#Aso 2.1; Yoh 7.3 Na yeinom nyinaa de akoma korɔ kura mpaebɔ mu ara, wɔne mmaa no ne Maria, Yesu ne na ne ne nuanom.
Petro asɛnka
15Na nna yi mu Petro sɔre gyinaa anuanom no mfimfini (na nkurɔfokuo a wɔahyia faako no bɛyɛ nnipa ɔha aduonu) na ɔkaa sɛ: 16#Dwom 41.9 Anuanom, ɛtwa sɛ twerɛ no a Honhom Kronkron nam Dawid anomu nsɛm so kaa no akane no nya ba mu wɔ Yuda a ɔyɛɛ wɔn a wɔkyeree Yesu no kwankyerɛfoɔ no ho. 17Na wɔkann no fraa yɛn, na ɔnyaa ɛsom yi kyɛfa bi somee. 18#Mat 27.3-10 (Saa Yuda yi na ɔde n’amumuyɛ akatua nyaa asase, na ne nkɔnkɔ bɛwɔɔ hɔ no, ne mu paee, na ne yam adeɛ nyinaa tu gui; 19na wɔn a wɔte Yerusalem nyinaa tee, na wɔfrɛɛ asase no wɔn ara wɔn kasa mu sɛ Hakeldama, aseɛ ne Mogya Asase.) 20#Dwom 69.25; 109.8 Na wɔatwerɛ no Nnwom nwoma mu sɛ:
Ne tenaberɛ nyɛ amamfo,
na obiara nntena mu!
Na ne hwɛ adwuma no deɛ, ɔfoforɔ mfa!
21 # Yoh 15.27 Enti ɛtwa sɛ mmarima a wɔne yɛn nanteeɛ berɛ a Awurade Yesu dii yɛn mu ahyemfire no nyinaa 22firi Yohane asubɔ so de bɛsi da a wɔfaa no yɛn nkyɛn kɔɔ soro no mu baako ne yɛn yɛ ne sɔreɛ ho adansefoɔ.
Matia yie
23Na wɔde baanu bɛgyinaa hɔ, Yosef a wɔfrɛ no Barsaba a wɔtoo no Yusto no, ne Matia. 24Na wɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: Wo, Awurade a wonim nnipa nyinaa akoma mu, kyerɛ baanu yi mu baako a woayi no 25sɛ ɔmfa ɛsom yi ne asomafodwuma a Yuda firii mu teree ho sɛ ɔrekɔ ɔno ara tenaberɛ no kyɛfa no nsom! 26#Mmb 16.33 Na wɔtwee wɔn so ntonto; na ntonto no bɔɔ Matia, na wɔkann no kaa asomafoɔ dubaako no ho.

pageProps.chapterText:
Teofilo, akane nwoma a meyɛeɛ no fa nnoɔma a Yesu firii aseɛ yɛeɛ, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛeɛ nyinaa de bɛsii da a ɔnam Honhom Kronkron soɔ maa asomafoɔ a ɔyii wɔn no ahyɛdeɛ, na wɔfaa no kɔɔ soro no ho. Wɔn nso na n’amanehunu akyiri no, ɔnam adanseɛ bebree so yii ne ho kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ ɔteasefoɔ adaduanan mu maa wɔhunuu no, na ɔkaa Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛm. Na ɔne wɔn hyiaeɛ no, ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmfiri Yerusalem nnkɔ, na mmom wɔntwɛn Agya no bɔhyɛ a ɔse: Mote firii m’anomu no, sɛ Yohane deɛ, ɔde nsuo na ɛbɔɔ asu, na mo deɛ, nna yi mu, ɛrenkyɛ na wɔbɛbɔ mo asu Honhom Kronkron mu.
Ɛnna wɔhyiaeɛ no, wɔbisaa no sɛ: Awurade, berɛ yi mu na wobɛsane de ahennie no ama Israel anaa? Na ɔbuaa wɔn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mo asɛm, sɛ mobɛhunu berɛ anaa nna a Agya no ahyɛ ato hɔ ɔno ara ne tumi mu, na mmom sɛ Honhom Kronkron no nya ba mo so a, mobɛnya ahoɔden, na moayɛ m’adansefoɔ Yerusalem ne Yudea nyinaa ne Samaria de akɔpem asase ano nohoa.

Na ɔkaa yeinom wieeɛ na wɔrehwɛ no no, wɔmaa no so, na mununkum gyee no firii wɔn anim. Na ɔrekorɔ na wɔrehwɛ soro haa no, hwɛ, mmarima baanu bi a wɔhyɛ ntadeɛ fitaa bɛgyinaa wɔn nkyɛn, na wɔkaa nso sɛ: Galilea mmarima, adɛn na mogyina ha rehwɛ soro yi? Yesu yi ara a wɔafa no mo nkyɛn kɔ soro yi, ɔbɛba saa ara, sɛdeɛ mohu no sɛ ɔrekɔ soro yi.

Ɛno na wɔfirii bepɔ a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔ a ɛbɛn Yerusalem bɛyɛ homeda kwan no so sane kɔɔ Yerusalem. Na wɔduruu hɔ no, wɔkɔɔ abansoro dan no mu; ɛhɔ na na Petro ne Yohane ne Yakobo ne Andrea, Filipo ne Toma, Bartolomeo ne Mateo, Alfeo ba Yakobo ne Simon Selote ne Yakobo ba Yuda teɛ. Na yeinom nyinaa de akoma korɔ kura mpaebɔ mu ara, wɔne mmaa no ne Maria, Yesu ne na ne ne nuanom.

Na nna yi mu Petro sɔre gyinaa anuanom no mfimfini (na nkurɔfokuo a wɔahyia faako no bɛyɛ nnipa ɔha aduonu) na ɔkaa sɛ: Anuanom, ɛtwa sɛ twerɛ no a Honhom Kronkron nam Dawid anomu nsɛm so kaa no akane no nya ba mu wɔ Yuda a ɔyɛɛ wɔn a wɔkyeree Yesu no kwankyerɛfoɔ no ho. Na wɔkann no fraa yɛn, na ɔnyaa ɛsom yi kyɛfa bi somee. (Saa Yuda yi na ɔde n’amumuyɛ akatua nyaa asase, na ne nkɔnkɔ bɛwɔɔ hɔ no, ne mu paee, na ne yam adeɛ nyinaa tu gui; na wɔn a wɔte Yerusalem nyinaa tee, na wɔfrɛɛ asase no wɔn ara wɔn kasa mu sɛ Hakeldama, aseɛ ne Mogya Asase.) Na wɔatwerɛ no Nnwom nwoma mu sɛ:
Ne tenaberɛ nyɛ amamfo,
na obiara nntena mu!
Na ne hwɛ adwuma no deɛ, ɔfoforɔ mfa!
Enti ɛtwa sɛ mmarima a wɔne yɛn nanteeɛ berɛ a Awurade Yesu dii yɛn mu ahyemfire no nyinaa firi Yohane asubɔ so de bɛsi da a wɔfaa no yɛn nkyɛn kɔɔ soro no mu baako ne yɛn yɛ ne sɔreɛ ho adansefoɔ.

Na wɔde baanu bɛgyinaa hɔ, Yosef a wɔfrɛ no Barsaba a wɔtoo no Yusto no, ne Matia. Na wɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: Wo, Awurade a wonim nnipa nyinaa akoma mu, kyerɛ baanu yi mu baako a woayi no sɛ ɔmfa ɛsom yi ne asomafodwuma a Yuda firii mu teree ho sɛ ɔrekɔ ɔno ara tenaberɛ no kyɛfa no nsom! Na wɔtwee wɔn so ntonto; na ntonto no bɔɔ Matia, na wɔkann no kaa asomafoɔ dubaako no ho.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
